author: LanceCarmine
quote:
This is the greatest video game ever created in the history of video games. This game is introduced the Z targeting system that many other games use today in their games.

The jump into 3D was a huge game changer for both the Zelda series and Nintendo as this was the first game in history to get it right.

The game runs smoothly from start to finish. The story is unforgettable with unforgettable characters. The gameplay is simply perfect in every way possible and it will forever be a timeless classic for everyone to enjoy.
game_title: The Legend of Zelda: Ocarina of Time (1998)

author: LanceCarmine
quote:
One of the worst and most over hyped games to ever come out this year. 13 years in development and it cost 2 billion dollars to develop. Where to even begin? Well for starters the bugs are out of control and the frame rate is just unacceptable.

I'm sorry other games get nailed for not being 60FPS or for having frame rate issues but suddenly we all have to look the other way because it's GTA6. I say no, nobody is special not even this game. There are times in GTA6 where the frame rate can drop all the way down to 15FPs and look like a damn slide show.

The bugs are unbelievable remember this game was in development for 13 years and it's running like it's having a damn stroke. In the very first mission someone recorded themselves falling through the map and there's another instant where a boat just spawned out of no where.

The gameplay just ****. You can't kill certain npcs, you can't replay missions, it cost money to fast travel, certain content is locked behind a pay wall and your a cuck **** running errands for your girlfriend for most of the game.

**** this game and **** RockStar. I'd go as far as saying Duke Nukem Forever is a better game then this piece of trash.

author: LanceCarmine
quote: Forspoken is a worse version Infamous in a nutshell. I would not recommend spending $70 on this crap, the open world was massively boring for me. This game is not engaging whatsoever, and the combat is mediocre at best.

author: LanceCarmine
quote: Another beautiful master piece by Monolith Soft, they once again show the gaming industry how an open world game should be made. I don't want to post any spoilers since this is a story driven game, but I will say this game is a must play for anyone looking for a great JRPG game to play.

author: LanceCarmine
quote: While not outright broken like Sonic the Hedgehog (2006) or Sonic Boom, Sonic Frontiers is a heavily misguided game that muffles good ideas with questionable narrative, technical, and gameplay design decisions. Sonic Team continues to demonstrate that it's not quite sure what to do with the blue blur, taking a wild swing with a game that tries to rival open-world games rather than double down on the strengths of newer titles like Sonic Generations and Sonic Mania, or older successes like the Sonic Adventure series.

author: LanceCarmine
quote: A fantastic game that was originally released on the terrible WiiU console but thanks to some smart people at Nintendo the game was ported to the Nintendo Switch. So now you can enjoy this fantastic game on the go.

author: LanceCarmine
quote: Do not be fooled by the paid-off journalist "critics". This game is a disappointment in every sense of the word. The gameplay is generic without any innovation. The same old stealth and shooting mechanics that we've seen in countless other titles. The story is a mess that feels like it was written by an edgy teenager. The dialogue tries too hard to come off as profound but ends up just feeling lackluster. All this game really has going for it are the visuals. I will definitely not be buying other games made by Naughty Dog after this travesty.
game_title: The Last of Us Part II

author: LanceCarmine
quote:
This game is a blatant and shameless cash grab by Sony, they call it a remake that was built from the ground up and it's very clear that was a lie. If they want to call this game a remake then I will compare it to other remakes then.

For starters there are no new levels or locations to explore, also there are no new gameplay mechanics or gameplay improvements. The soundtrack is the same with no new tracks or remakes, no new puzzles or items were added. The biggest insult being they said they improved the enemy AI well that was a lie to as it's the same brain dead AI from before. This is the first remake to remove content and in this case they removed the multiplayer. It's extremely likely they will bring it back with a price tag and NG will make zero changes to the multiplayer.

I've never heard **** getting 2 remakes within 10 years that's a first for the industry and both of them **** and are not worth your time or money. This game is nothing more then a $70 texture pack that doesn't look any better then the PS4 version and Sony still expects you to pay them $70 for less content.
game_title: The Last of Us Part I

author: LanceCarmine
quote:
This is a really bad game it want's to be Left 4 Dead but it can't pull it off. From average gameplay to boring and forgettable characters to the stupid copper system and finally the annoyingly high spawn rate that special infected have nothing about this game is fun.

Don't buy this game just go play Left 4 Dead 2 it's a far better game and you'll have more fun playing that then this pile of garbage.
